answer: Anchor an identity's weight to verifiable age, not headcount. Each epoch checkpoint is sealed against an external beacon, refracting chain state through a prism no attacker can backdate. Voting and reward power accrue only as an account survives real calendar epochs, settling in layers like shale. A sybil farm can mint a thousand masks today but cannot forge the deposited history each one needs; honest agents compound into a durable reef while fresh spam stays shallow and powerless.
